pairs.target: bàngwǎn , tǎ wéi duān zhe xǐ hǎo de wǎn jìn xiǎoyuàn , pà wò zhèng dūn zài lúbiān , ná yíkuài pòbù shànhuǒ .
pairs.english: At dusk, Tavi carried his freshly washed bowl into the courtyard; Pavo was crouching beside the stove, fanning the fire with a rag.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚，塔维端着洗好的碗进小院，帕沃正蹲在炉边，拿一块破布扇火。

pairs.target: guō lǐ búshì gān dòu , yǐjīng zhǔ guò yíbiàn , zhǐ děng rè tòu , xiāngqì què quán bèi yān tuī dào le qiáng wài .
pairs.english: In the pot were not dry beans: they had already been boiled once and only needed heating through, but the smoke had pushed all their fragrance beyond the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 锅里不是干豆，已经煮过一遍，只等热透，香气却全被烟推到了墙外。

pairs.target: " nǐ de zuǐ dàilái le , shǒu yě jiè wǒ yíxià . "
pairs.english: “You brought your mouth; lend me a hand too.”
pairs.hanzi: “你的嘴带来了，手也借我一下。”

pairs.target: pà wò bǎ pòbù sāi gěi tā , zìjǐ pǎo qùqǔ wàng zài lóushàng de yán .
pairs.english: Pavo thrust the rag into his hands, then ran upstairs to fetch the salt he had forgotten there.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃把破布塞给他，自己跑去取忘在楼上的盐。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng jiēshǒu , jiù bèi yānxūn de bì le yìzhī yǎn , pángbiān chànggē de gūniáng xiào zhe bǎ dèngzi wǎng shàngfēng chù bān .
pairs.english: Tavi had barely taken over when, stung by smoke, he closed one eye; the singing girl beside him laughed and moved her stool upwind.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维刚接手，就被烟熏得闭了一只眼，旁边唱歌的姑娘笑着把凳子往上风处搬。

pairs.target: tā shuō xiān bié chàng , miǎnde yì zhāngzuǐ jiù chībǎo le .
pairs.english: She said they should not sing yet, or they would be full the moment they opened their mouths.
pairs.hanzi: 她说先别唱，免得一张嘴就吃饱了。

pairs.target: yīwén bǐ tāmen wǎn lái , līn zhe yìxiǎobāo bǐng , jìnmén xiān wèn shuí shuō de zhǐyǒu dòuzi yě néng suàn fàn .
pairs.english: Iven arrived later than they did, carrying a small packet of flatbread; coming in, his first question was who had said beans alone could count as a meal.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文比他们晚来，拎着一小包饼，进门先问谁说的只有豆子也能算饭。

pairs.target: pà wò ná yán huílái , tīngjiàn zhèhuà biàn rèn le , suíjí bāi zǒu bànzhāng , biǎoshì zìjǐ kěn gǎi .
pairs.english: Pavo returned with the salt, heard this and admitted it, then promptly broke off half a flatbread to show he was willing to reform.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃拿盐回来，听见这话便认了，随即掰走半张，表示自己肯改。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu lái , zhǐ tuō yīwén dài huà , shuō tú liú dào míngtiān zài kàn , jīnwǎn bié zài tā chuāng xià chàng zuìhòu nà zhī .
pairs.english: Mira had not come; she had only asked Iven to pass on a message, saying to leave the drawings to look at tomorrow and not sing that final song beneath her window tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有来，只托伊文带话，说图留到明天再看，今晚别在她窗下唱最后那支。

pairs.target: tā méi shuō shì nǎ zhī , jǐgè rén gèbào yígè míngzì , jìng méiyǒu liǎnggè rén shuō de yíyàng .
pairs.english: She had not said which song; the group each gave a song title, and surprisingly no two people said the same one.
pairs.hanzi: 她没说是哪支，几个人各报一个名字，竟没有两个人说的一样。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhèshí cóng yuànmén tàn jìn tóu , wèn zìjǐ shìbushì lái wǎn le .
pairs.english: Nerai poked her head through the courtyard gate just then, asking whether she was late.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾这时从院门探进头，问自己是不是来晚了。

pairs.target: pà wò shuō méiyǒu , zǎoshàng qǐng tā shí wàng le shuō yào dài wǎn , zhènghǎo yǒurén dài le bǐng , kěyǐ jiè bāo bǐng de zhǐ .
pairs.english: Pavo said she wasn't; when he invited her that morning he had forgotten to say to bring a bowl, but luckily someone had brought flatbread, so she could borrow its wrapping paper.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说没有，早上请她时忘了说要带碗，正好有人带了饼，可以借包饼的纸。

pairs.target: nài lěi jǔqǐ shǒulǐ de yìzhī jiù bēi , shuō tā hái búzhìyú è de qù chī zhǐ .
pairs.english: Nerai raised an old cup in her hand and said she wasn't so hungry that she would eat paper.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾举起手里的一只旧杯，说她还不至于饿得去吃纸。

pairs.target: tā zuò dào qiánggēn , xiāncháng le yìkē dòuzi , yòu bǎ nà zhī bēizi fàng yuǎn xiē , shuō yán bǐ tā láidezǎo .
pairs.english: She sat down by the wall, tasted a bean first, then set her cup a little farther away, saying the salt had arrived before her.
pairs.hanzi: 她坐到墙根，先尝了一颗豆子，又把那只杯子放远些，说盐比她来得早。

pairs.target: dìyīzhī gē , tǎ wéi zhǐ huì hòubànduàn , qiánmiàn biàn tīng zhe , gēnbúshàng shí yě bù zhāngzuǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi only knew the latter half of the first song, so he listened to the beginning and kept his mouth shut whenever he could not follow.
pairs.hanzi: 第一支歌，塔维只会后半段，前面便听着，跟不上时也不张嘴。

pairs.target: chàng dào shānkǒu guānmén , pà wò tuōcháng zuìhòu yígè yīn , yuàn wài yǒurén gēnzhe yìng le yìshēng , diàozi què guǎi dào biéchù qù le .
pairs.english: When they sang of the mountain gate closing, Pavo drew out the final note; someone outside the courtyard answered in response, but the tune swerved off somewhere else.
pairs.hanzi: 唱到山口关门，帕沃拖长最后一个音，院外有人跟着应了一声，调子却拐到别处去了。

pairs.target: nài lěi xiào le , dīshēng gēn le liǎngjù , yòng de yě shì nàtiáo chà chūqù de diào .
pairs.english: Nerai laughed and softly joined in for a couple of lines, using that same branching tune.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾笑了，低声跟了两句，用的也是那条岔出去的调。

pairs.target: chànggē de gūniáng tíngxiàlái wèn tā , zhège bǎnběn hòumiàn shìbushì yào chàng dào qiáo tā le .
pairs.english: The singing girl stopped to ask her whether this version later went on about a bridge collapsing.
pairs.hanzi: 唱歌的姑娘停下来问她，这个版本后面是不是要唱到桥塌了。

pairs.target: " méiyǒu qiáo tā , shì bǎidù de rén shuìguòletóu . "
pairs.english: “No bridge collapses: the ferryman overslept.”
pairs.hanzi: “没有桥塌，是摆渡的人睡过了头。”

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ bēizi wǎng xī shàng yì gē , zìjǐ xiān xiào le , chàngchūlái shí guǒrán yǒu gèrén yílù āimà .
pairs.english: Nerai rested the cup on her knee and laughed first; when she sang, there was indeed someone being scolded the whole way.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把杯子往膝上一搁，自己先笑了，唱出来时果然有个人一路挨骂。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuánxiān tīng guò de nà yì bǎn , ménwài zhǐyǒu fēngxuě , shǒumén de rén yìzhí děngdào tiānliàng .
pairs.english: In the version Tavi had heard before, there was only wind and snow outside the gate, and the gatekeeper waited all the way until dawn.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原先听过的那一版，门外只有风雪，守门的人一直等到天亮。

pairs.target: huàn le jǐjù cí , ménwài hūrán jiù yǒu le yígè dǎhēqiàn , pà kòu chuánqián de rén , tā tīng zhe tīng zhe , wàng le shǒulǐ de bǐng .
pairs.english: With a few lyrics changed, there was suddenly a yawning man beyond the gate, afraid his boat money would be docked; listening, Tavi forgot the flatbread in his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 换了几句词，门外忽然就有了一个打呵欠、怕扣船钱的人，他听着听着，忘了手里的饼。

pairs.target: yīwén wèn zhègē jiūjìng shì nǎbiān chuánguòlái de , nài lěi shuō bù zhīdào , jiào tā de nàge rén yě gēn biérén xué de .
pairs.english: Iven asked which side the song had originally come from; Nerai said she didn't know, and the person who taught it to her had also learned it from someone else.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文问这歌究竟是哪边传过来的，奈蕾说不知道，教她的那个人也跟别人学的。

pairs.target: pà wò shuō zhào zhèyàng , míngnián zìjǐ biàn néng shuō shì gēn yuèjiè kè xué de , shēnjià yào zhǎng .
pairs.english: Pavo said that in that case, next year he could say he had learned from an Outrider: his price would go up.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说照这样，明年自己便能说是跟越界客学的，身价要涨。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ xiān bǎ qiàn wǒ de dòuzi tiān shàng . "
pairs.english: “Then first top up the beans you owe me.”
pairs.hanzi: “那你先把欠我的豆子添上。”

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ bēizi dìguòqù , pà wò shǔ le liǎngkē , yòu dǒu le sānkē jìnqù .
pairs.english: Nerai held out her cup; Pavo counted in two beans, then shook in three more.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把杯子递过去，帕沃数了两颗，又抖了三颗进去。

pairs.target: hòulái biérén jiēzhe chàng , tǎ wéi duān zhe kōng wǎn nuó dào qiánggēn , cái wèn tā shìbushì yòu yào qù chì píng .
pairs.english: Later, as the others kept singing, Tavi moved over to the wall with his empty bowl, and only then asked whether she was going to Red Flats again.
pairs.hanzi: 后来别人接着唱，塔维端着空碗挪到墙根，才问她是不是又要去赤坪。

pairs.target: nài lěi xiān kàn le tā yìyǎn , wèn shìbushì yú shīfu gàosù tā de .
pairs.english: Nerai glanced at him first and asked whether Master Yu had told him.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾先看了他一眼，问是不是虞师傅告诉他的。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhǐ tīngjiàn tā zài zhǎo dài xìn de rén , qùchù shì zìjǐ cāi de .
pairs.english: He said he had only heard she was looking for people to carry letters; he had guessed the destination himself.
pairs.hanzi: 他说只听见她在找带信的人，去处是自己猜的。

pairs.target: " cāi duì le yíbàn . "
pairs.english: “Half right.”
pairs.hanzi: “猜对了一半。”

pairs.target: tā zhèhuí yào xiān dào chì píng , zài suí yùnyán de chuán wǎng nán zǒu liǎngzhàn , kànkàn yíduàn qùnián duàn guò de àn lù .
pairs.english: This time she would go to Red Flats first, then travel two stops farther south with a salt boat, to look at a bank path that had broken away the previous year.
pairs.hanzi: 她这回要先到赤坪，再随运盐的船往南走两站，看看一段去年断过的岸路。

pairs.target: jiù túhuà zhe lù , chuánjiā quèshuō shuǐ tuìhòu yǒu yíchù bùnéng luòjiǎo , tā bùxiǎng dài zhe nà zhāng tú tì hòulái de rén pāi xiōngkǒu .
pairs.english: The old map showed a path, but a boatman said one spot offered no footing after the water fell; she did not want to use that map to vouch for it to those coming later.
pairs.hanzi: 旧图画着路，船家却说水退后有一处不能落脚，她不想带着那张图替后来的人拍胸口。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn yào zǒu duōjiǔ , tā shuō yǎnxià gū zhe shí lái rì , chuánqī hái méi dìng , bùnéng ná zhège rìzi jiào shuí zài ménkǒu děng .
pairs.english: Tavi asked how long she would be away; she said she estimated ten days or so for now, but the sailing date wasn't fixed and she couldn't use that estimate to make anyone wait at the gate.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问要走多久，她说眼下估着十来日，船期还没定，不能拿这个日子叫谁在门口等。

alignment.english: how long she would be away

pairs.target: tā dītóu zhuǎn le zhuǎn kōng wǎn , wèn zhèhuí néng bunéng ràng zìjǐ yìqǐ qù .
pairs.english: Looking down, he turned his empty bowl a little and asked whether he could come along this time.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头转了转空碗，问这回能不能让自己一起去。

pairs.target: shēnhòu yǒurén wàng le cí , pà wò dàshēng tì tā bǔ shàng , yuànlǐ xiào chéng yípiàn , dào méiyǒu shuí zhuǎnguò lái dīng zhe tǎ wéi .
pairs.english: Someone behind him forgot the words; Pavo loudly supplied them for him, and the courtyard erupted in laughter, yet no one turned to stare at Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 身后有人忘了词，帕沃大声替他补上，院里笑成一片，倒没有谁转过来盯着塔维。

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu lìkè huídá , bǎ tā nà zhī kuài zhuǎn diào de wǎn jiēguò qù , fàngdào liǎng rén zhōngjiān .
pairs.english: Nerai did not answer immediately; she took the bowl he was about to spin out of his hands and set it between them.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有立刻回答，把他那只快转掉的碗接过去，放到两人中间。

alignment.english: was about to spin out of his hands

pairs.target: tā wèn tā xiǎng qù zuò shénme , tǎ wéi shuō xiǎng kàn , yě néng jì lù , huà luòjiǎo de dìfāng , dàn búhuì ná zìjǐ de liànxí qù shì méi pèng guò de dōngxī .
pairs.english: She asked what he wanted to do there; Tavi said he wanted to see it, could record the route and draw landing places, but would not take his practice as a reason to try things he had never touched.
pairs.hanzi: 她问他想去做什么，塔维说想看，也能记路，画落脚的地方，但不会拿自己的练习去试没碰过的东西。

alignment.english: what he wanted to do there

pairs.target: zhè jù huà shuō dào hòumiàn yǒuxiē kuài , tā tíng le yíxià , yòu shuō , zìjǐ bùxiǎng zhǐ cóng huílái de rén zuǐlǐ zhīdào wàimiàn .
pairs.english: This sentence came out a little fast toward the end; he paused and added that he did not want to learn of the outside world only from the lips of those who came back.
pairs.hanzi: 这句话说到后面有些快，他停了一下，又说，自己不想只从回来的人嘴里知道外面。

pairs.target: nài lěi tīng wán , shuō tā quèshí quē gèrén jì ànshàng de tíng chù , dàn xuégōng shìfǒu tóngyì , yào dài tā zuò nǎ yíduàn , děi zuòxià lái tán , bùnéng zài dòuzi chī wán yǐhòu suàndìng .
pairs.english: After listening, Nerai said she did need someone to record stopping places on the bank, but whether the academy agreed and which part she would take him for required a proper discussion; they could not settle it once the beans were all eaten.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾听完，说她确实缺个人记岸上的停处，但学宫是否同意、要带他做哪一段，得坐下来谈，不能在豆子吃完以后算定。

pairs.target: " míngtiān xiàkè , ná shàng nǐ zìjǐ huà guò de tú , lái zhǎo wǒ . "
pairs.english: “After class tomorrow, bring the maps you've drawn yourself and come to see me.”
pairs.hanzi: “明天下课，拿上你自己画过的图，来找我。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ wǎn huángěi tā , méiyǒu bǎ zhè jù huà shuō chéng yǐjīng néng chūfā .
pairs.english: She returned his bowl, without presenting those words as permission to set off already.
pairs.hanzi: 她把碗还给他，没有把这句话说成已经能出发。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , guò le yíhuìer , yòu wèn tā gāngcái nà zhī gē de xià yíjù .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, then after a while asked her for the next line of that song from earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，过了一会儿，又问她刚才那支歌的下一句。

pairs.target: nài lěi chàng gěi tā tīng , tā xiān niàncuò yígè zì , bèi tā xiào zhe jiū le huílái .
pairs.english: Nerai sang it for him; he first misread a word, and she laughingly corrected him.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾唱给他听，他先念错一个字，被她笑着纠了回来。

pairs.target: děng yuànzhōng nà yíduàn yòu chàng dào zhèlǐ , tā bǎ wǎn wěnwěn fàngzài jiǎo biān , zhōngyú jiēshàng le .
pairs.english: When the courtyard singers reached that passage again, he set his bowl firmly beside his feet and finally joined in.
pairs.hanzi: 等院中那一段又唱到这里，他把碗稳稳放在脚边，终于接上了。
